meta.title: The Kaffe Loopie — Coffee. Brunch. Sweet Moments. | Baku
meta.description: Coffee, all-day breakfast and homemade desserts next to Baku's Old City. 4.9 ★ on Google. Open daily 07:00–23:00. Pet friendly.

news.title: This week at The Kaffe
news.sezarText: Caesar in flatbread with fresh salad — on the breakfast menu.

split.dessertsText: Tiramisu, panna cotta, magnolia pudding and energy balls. Our guests call the tiramisu "the best I ever had".
split.breakfastText: Shakshuka, Rice Bowl, Caesar roll and croissants — from 07:00 to 23:00, all day long.

menu.title: Our menu
menu.metaDescription: The Kaffe menu: coffee, cold drinks, tea, all-day breakfast and homemade desserts — with prices and extras.

about.title: Fresh coffee, homemade desserts, and a place that feels like home in Baku.
about.p1: The Kaffe Loopie is a small, warm coffee house on Istiqlaliyyat Street, one step from Icherisheher. Here the day starts with coffee, breakfast goes on all day, and the desserts are made in-house.
about.p2: We're pet friendly: we adopt our cats from the street, and they often keep our guests company. 🐾
